findings.evidence: Roots.lean:38-39 `tarskiQuery p q = signSum p.roots.toFinset q := (rfl)`; each proof at 44, 50, 54, 58, 63, 85, 92 is a single `rw`/`simp [tarskiQuery_eq_signSum, <the signSum lemma>]`, and `signSum_zero`/`signSum_one` (Polynomial.lean:112,116) are `@[simp]` so 57 and 61 are already closed by the component lemmas. `grep -rn tarskiQuery ./code/TauCeti` → Roots.lean only; `grep -rni tarski ./mathlib/Mathlib` → only Sturm/Sequence.lean prose.
findings.fix: Keep `tarskiQuery`, `tarskiQuery_eq_signSum` (mark it `@[simp]` so the signSum simp lemmas fire through it), `tarskiQuery_zero_left` (genuine content: `(0 : R[X]).roots = 0`) and `signCount_roots_pos` (genuine content: `mem_roots`); delete the six listed restatements and let callers use the `Finset.signSum`/`signCount` lemmas after `tarskiQuery_eq_signSum`.
findings.issue: Five/six declarations are instantiation-only restatements of the signSum API at Z := p.roots.toFinset: tarskiQuery_eq_sum (42) = signSum_eq_sum, tarskiQuery_eq_card_sub_card (47) = signSum_eq_card_sub_card, tarskiQuery_zero_right (57) = signSum_zero, tarskiQuery_one (61) = signSum_one, tarskiQuery_eq_sum_signCount (80) = signSum_eq_sum_signCount, fullInverse_mulVec_tarskiQuery (88) = fullInverse_mulVec_signSum. None has a consumer.

findings.evidence: `grep -rn occCount_solution_pos_iff ./code/TauCeti` → only OccCount.lean:62 (the declaration itself). OccCount.lean:72-74, Polynomial.lean:222-223 and Polynomial.lean:249-250 are the identical two-line proof `rw [<eq lemma>]; simp only [Nat.cast_pos, <pos lemma>]`. `Function.occCount_pos` is `@[simp, grind =]` at Fiber.lean:86-88; `Finset.signCount_pos` is `@[simp, grind =]` at Polynomial.lean:88.
findings.fix: Delete `Function.occCount_solution_pos_iff` (OccCount.lean:62-75) and `fullInverse_mulVec_signSum_pos` (Polynomial.lean:245-250), keeping only `signCount_solution_pos_iff`; users get the other two with one `simp [eq_occCount ...]` / `simp [fullInverse_mulVec_signSum]` since `Function.occCount_pos` and `Finset.signCount_pos` are already `@[simp]`.
findings.issue: `Function.occCount_solution_pos_iff` is dead and duplicated. It is `eq_occCount` + the `@[simp]` lemma `occCount_pos` + `Nat.cast_pos`; nothing references it, and its intended specialization `Finset.signCount_solution_pos_iff` (Polynomial.lean:210) re-derives the same statement from `eq_signCount` + `signCount_pos` instead of using it. `Finset.fullInverse_mulVec_signSum_pos` (Polynomial.lean:245) is a third copy of the same composite.

summary: The abstract moment/tensor-inverse material is genuinely new (no Mathlib counterpart: only Sturm/Sequence.lean mentions Sturm–Tarski, and there is no sign-count or moment-inverse API), and the previously flagged re-proofs of mulVec_signCount and eq_occCount are now proper delegations. Two duplications remain: Roots.lean mirrors six signSum lemmas at Z := p.roots.toFinset, and three copies of the same "solved entry positive iff realized" composite exist, one of them dead.
